The agent just discovered that no C compiler is available in the environment (memory entry [00000010]). Before proceeding with the configure script and gcov instrumentation, the agent needs to install build tools.

The environment lacks gcc/build-essential, which is blocking the configure script from running. The typical solution is to install the necessary build tools (gcc, g++, make, build-essential) using the system package manager before attempting to configure or compile SQLite.

Once build tools are installed, the agent can proceed with:
1. Running `./configure` with CFLAGS containing gcov instrumentation flags (--coverage or -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage)
2. Running make to compile
3. Installing to /app/sqlite
4. Adding /app/sqlite to PATH
